# Define the persona scorecards, including cost per session and latency

**Why:** A stranger pays only if the game delights the people it's for, and we can't price without knowing the cost.

**Unblocks:** Self-play scoring, release gate, pricing data.

## Context

Seeded from Roadmap 2027 rev. 3 (2026-10-05). North star: the first paying customer the founders don't personally know.
